input.why: No documented function for this key in Elden Ring and no habit history for it; assigned an otherwise-unused soft-puff gesture as a low-risk placeholder consistent with the sip/puff vocabulary used elsewhere in this profile, pending their review.

input.summary: All 30 controls are now settled or awaiting the user's answer. Evidenced from clear majority habits: left_joy_down, right_stick, right_bumper, left_bumper, left_trigger, B, X, Y. Adjusted-for-context (inferred): left_stick and left_joy_down function changed to toggle to match Elden Ring's on/off stance and lock-on behavior. Thin/tied history, picked at low confidence: dpad_W, dpad_E, dpad_N, dpad_S, start, back. The 13 kb_*/mouse_right_button outputs have no habit history at all; where Elden Ring's default PC scheme gives them a clear job matching one already decided (kb_w/kb_s=forward/back, kb_e=interact, kb_q=weapon skill, kb_left_shift=dodge, kb_left_control=crouch, mouse_right_button=guard, kb_x=two-hand), they were mirrored from that decision, all marked inferred. The remaining keys with no game function at all (kb_a, kb_c, kb_f, kb_f1, kb_h) were given otherwise-unused placeholder gestures, also inferred, flagged for the user's review since these carry the least evidence in the whole profile. Two questions are still open with the user: left_joy_up (puff vs joystick-tilt for forward movement) and right_trigger (puff vs joystick-tilt for strong attack), since their own history splits close to evenly on both.
